payload.title: Image toolchain step 6: OpenAI adapter, standard and Batch
payload.description:
Build step 6 of the image toolchain (design: project/wiki/image-toolchain.md, section 9).

Images endpoints only (`/v1/images/generations`, `/v1/images/edits`), `models.json` for `gpt-image-2.5-flare` (and `-sunburst` declared but not enabled), Batch JSONL submission and output parsing, size and transparency mapping, recorded-response contract tests (no live calls in CI), SSM key from the PPY-6af46b rotation, price entries for both lanes. Then switch on the Machines on Machines trial: `provider: openai`, `model: gpt-image-2.5-flare`, `approved: true`.

Specs: `image-provider-openai.feature` with recorded fixtures: one request per candidate; batch lines matched by `custom_id`; error lines and expiry handled per candidate; unsupported size returns `capability_unsupported`; actual model and lane recorded.

What deploys: Lambda code; trial on MoM only.

Fulfils or changes: c101a6, 7c3f6a, f0af42 (decision recorded).

Gherkin specs are required, and every PR merges to develop. Spending is only approved for step 6 (OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare, Machines on Machines trial; Batch where nobody waits). Style guidance is data, never code.
